summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Abivax S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting its interim financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains unaudited consolidated financial statements prepared under IFRS, with notes describing share capital and warrant transactions, convertible notes, and compensation plans. It does not announce any M&A, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation corporate event. The disclosure is a routine quarterly earnings update, equivalent to a Form 10-Q or 6-K earnings release. No deal terms are applicable.
